dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 時間まで待ちますか
dialogue.English: Shall we wait until our scheduled time?

dialogue.content: 今からでも時間からでも大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.English: I'm fine with starting now or at the scheduled time.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Let's begin.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 夫とのことで少し悩んでいます。
dialogue.English: I'm a bit troubled about things with my husband.

dialogue.content: 夫さんのことですか？年齢はおいくつですか？
dialogue.English: About your husband? How old is he?

dialogue.content: 私ですか？夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Me? Or my husband?

dialogue.content: 夫さんです
dialogue.English: Your husband.

dialogue.content: 夫の年齢、、
dialogue.English: My husband's age...

dialogue.content: 30歳ですが、、
dialogue.English: He's 30, but...

dialogue.content: はいわかりました
dialogue.English: I see, thank you.

dialogue.content: 夫さんどうされましたか
dialogue.English: What seems to be happening with your husband?

dialogue.content: 夫の息子への言い方が気になります。
dialogue.English: I'm concerned about the way my husband speaks to our son.

dialogue.content: たとえばどのような時どんないいかたをするのですか？
dialogue.English: For example, in what situations, and how does he speak to him?

dialogue.content: 片付けがてきていないときに、片付けろよ〜という普通のことなのですが、なんとかなく、キツく感じます。
dialogue.English: When our son hasn't tidied up, he'll say something ordinary enough, like 'Clean up!', but for some reason, it feels harsh.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 男の方は声も大きいし圧迫感がありますよね
dialogue.English: Men's voices are often louder, so they can feel more intimidating, can't they?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's true.

dialogue.content: 息子さんはそのことでなんとおっしゃっていますか
dialogue.English: What does your son say about that?

dialogue.content: 得には何もいってないです。
dialogue.English: He hasn't said anything in particular.

dialogue.content: キツイ言い方は前からですか
dialogue.English: Has he always spoken so harshly?

dialogue.content: 前からというな元々という感じです
dialogue.English: It's less that it's been for a while and more like it's just how he's always been.

dialogue.content: ↑いうか
dialogue.English: Or rather,

dialogue.content: の間違いです、、
dialogue.English: That was a mistake...

dialogue.content: 元々なんですね！夫さんにことばがきつくてすごくきいていてきずつとつたえてありますか
dialogue.English: So that's how he's always been! Have you told your husband that his words are harsh and that they're hurtful to hear?

dialogue.content: きずつ？
dialogue.English: Hurtful?

dialogue.content: 傷つくです
dialogue.English: Yes, hurtful.

dialogue.content: 傷ついてはいません、、
dialogue.English: I wouldn't say I'm hurt...

dialogue.content: きつく言われるとじぶんより息子さんのきもちのほうが心配になりますよね
dialogue.English: When he speaks harshly, you worry more about your son's feelings than your own, right?

dialogue.content: まぁ、それもあります
dialogue.English: Well, that's part of it.

dialogue.content: 男のかたは仕事できおつかうのでかぞくにはきのゆるみもありますよね
dialogue.English: Men often use a lot of energy at work, so they tend to let their guard down with family, don't they?

dialogue.content: そうですね、
dialogue.English: Yes, that's true.

dialogue.content: 夫さんにどうしてほしいですか
dialogue.English: What would you like your husband to do?

dialogue.content: もう少しやわらかい言い方をしてほしいですね
dialogue.English: I'd like him to speak a bit more gently.

dialogue.content: 夫さんにそのままの気持ちをつたえてみてはいかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: How about telling your husband exactly how you feel?

dialogue.content: もう何度も伝えています。
dialogue.English: I've already told him many times.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。じゃあ夫さんが言ってるようにきついことばでかえしてみて、どうかんじるかきいてみてはいかがですか
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, how about responding to him in the same harsh tone he uses and asking him how that feels?

dialogue.content: すみません、、なんだか、そういうことではなくて…
dialogue.English: I'm sorry... that's not really what this is about...

dialogue.content: すみません、勝手に思ってしまいました。夫さんに柔らかいいいかたをしてほしいのですね
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I made an assumption. You want your husband to speak more gently, right?

dialogue.content: うーん、夫の息子への言い方が気になる自分がいるということです
dialogue.English: Hmm... it's that I find myself bothered by the way my husband speaks to our son.

dialogue.content: 息子さんへのいいかたをきにしているのですね
dialogue.English: So you're concerned about the way he speaks to your son.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 息子さんに優しくふれてもらえると安心しますよね
dialogue.English: You would feel more at ease if he treated your son gently, wouldn't you?

dialogue.content: そうですね、、
dialogue.English: Yes, I would...

dialogue.content: 夫さんには何度も伝えているのですものね
dialogue.English: And you've told your husband this many times, haven't you?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 息子さんにお母さんはお父さんのことばはきつく」かんじるけどどおってきいてみてはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How about asking your son, 'Mom feels that Dad's words are harsh, but what do you think?'

dialogue.content: 聞くとそう思ってると言っています。
dialogue.English: When I ask him, he says he feels the same way.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは、そのことをどこまでかんがえてくれているのか？
dialogue.English: How seriously do you think your husband is considering this?

dialogue.content: 何度も伝えているので、真剣に、考えています。
dialogue.English: Since I've told him many times, he is thinking about it seriously.

dialogue.content: 優しい言い方にすこしずつ努力しようと考えていてくれていますね
dialogue.English: So he's thinking about gradually making an effort to speak more kindly, right?

dialogue.content: うーん、それもありますが、何故私がそんなに言い方が気になるのかを考えてくれています
dialogue.English: Hmm, there's that, but he's also thinking about why I'm so bothered by the way he speaks.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ほんとうは優しい夫さんのんだすね
dialogue.English: He's actually a kind husband, isn't he?

dialogue.content: なのですね、です
dialogue.English: I mean, '...isn't he?'

dialogue.content: そうですね、
dialogue.English: Yes, he is.

dialogue.content: 大事な息子さんだから力が入ってしまうのですね
dialogue.English: Because your son is so important to him, he comes on too strong, doesn't he?

dialogue.content: そう言うおとうさんに育ててもらってきっとむすこさんは、立派に成長されますよ
dialogue.English: Being raised by a father like that, I'm sure your son will grow up to be a fine young man.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、
dialogue.English: Yes, I suppose so...

dialogue.content: （もうそろそろ時間ですので、今日は終わりにして頂いて大丈夫です。）
dialogue.English: (It's almost time, so it's okay for us to finish for today.)

dialogue.content: （有難うございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: 男同士のやり取りだとおもって温かくみまもってください。。祈ってます
dialogue.English: Please try to see it as an interaction between father and son and watch over them warmly. I'll be keeping you in my thoughts.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。これで終了させて頂きます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today. We will conclude our session here.
